VICTORY DAY Celebration
2019-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/victory-day-celebration-1840156

Artistes of Bangladesh Rabindra Sangeet Shilpi Sangstha (BRSSS) performed on the opening day of the event, ‘Sarthak Janam Amar Janmechhi Ei Deshe’ at Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy, recently. BRSSS organised the event on the occasion of Victory Day 2019.
